status: runner contract only; no negative or mutation status is promoted

source_open: require regular file and stable device/inode/size/mtime/ctime
read each source exactly once and enforce per-role and aggregate bounds
snapshot_contract.private_snapshot: Linux anonymous sealed memfd per transaction, raw-input vector, and raw-output vector; descriptors inherited only by the isolated simulator child
snapshot_contract.submitted_binding: SHA-256 and byte length are computed from the exact bytes copied into each sealed memfd; the bound hashes and sizes are returned with the child result
snapshot_contract.target_policy_binding: the typed transaction's sole mint policy ID must equal the expected applied script hash derived from its Plutus V3 witness; both are returned as public identifiers
snapshot_contract.raw_data_handling: transaction bytes, raw input/output bytes, stdout, stderr, witnesses, and source paths are never persisted or returned as evidence

process_contract.invocation: aiken tx simulate --cbor <sealed transaction fd> <sealed raw-input fd> <sealed raw-output fd>
process_contract.argument_binding_failure: snapshot_binding_mismatch before child spawn; descriptor permutation is never delegated to simulator parsing

timeout_seconds.termination: SIGTERM, bounded grace, SIGKILL, bounded direct-child wait, and process-group-empty check

wrapper_exit.0: bounded result captured, exact R2 transcript classified as accepted or compiled-evaluation rejection, and cleanup succeeded
wrapper_exit.2: input/snapshot error, timeout, output overflow, indeterminate transcript, or cleanup failure

process_contract.classification: reuse the exact R2 Aiken 1.1.21/1.1.23 transcript classifier; never infer child status from an outer shell or wrapper status

always: terminate an outstanding process group on timeout or runner error
verify the isolated process group is empty
make any cleanup failure force wrapper exit 2

case_status_policy.negative_cases: all 55 original identifiers/assertions retain their existing R2 state; no automatic promotion
case_status_policy.compiled_mutations: all 21 original identifiers/assertions retain their existing R2 state; no automatic promotion
case_status_policy.authority_value_minus_one: remains PENDING until the R3 snapshot-bound dual-runtime result is independently approved
